title: Disco Party
about: Turning downtime on Zoom into an impromptu disco party while waiting for videos to upload.
description: This track remembers one of the unexpected moments that came from producing a show remotely. With the tech crew sitting on Zoom and nothing to do while videos uploaded, colored lights came on, bedrooms and living rooms became tiny dance floors, and I became the DJ. What started as waiting turned into an improvised disco party inside our webcam squares, proving that even when everything was happening from home, we could still find ways to have fun together and keep the show moving.
lyrics: Just making the best of waiting.
If the world was standing still...
Just making the best of waiting.
If the world was standing still...
Everyone danced with whatever lights they had.
Strange memories become the best ones.
If the world was standing still...
The show still found a way...
